p0006_1.t: Shops by Region and Number of Employees
p0006_1.d: Large shops (100 or more employees) by region of Japan and size class of workforce, with totals, percentages and bracketed sub-totals for shops under and over 500 employees, August 1931.

p0007_1.t: Shops by Type of Business and Number of Employees
p0007_1.d: Department stores and other large shops by type of business (with sub-types) and size class of workforce, with totals and percentages.

p0008_1.d: Employees of the surveyed shops by age group (under 16 to over 50) and sex, with totals and the share of all employees.

p0008_2.t: Shops by Whether They Trade at Night
p0008_2.d: Shops that never trade at night, trade at night occasionally or always, by size class of workforce, with numbers of employees and percentages.

p0009_1.t: Employees by Whether Their Shop Trades at Night
p0009_1.d: Employees by age group and sex in shops that never, always or occasionally trade at night, with totals.

p0009_2.t: [Shops by Season of Occasional Night Trading]
p0009_2.d: Shops trading at night only occasionally, by the seasons in which they do so (Bon, year-end, Saturdays and Sundays and other periods).

p0010_1.d: Shops by their opening time of day, separately for shops with the same opening time all year and those changing it by season, with remarks on cafés and restaurants inside the stores.

p0012_1.t: Closing Times of Shops Trading by Day Only
p0012_1.d: Shops by closing time of day, for shops with a fixed closing time all year and those changing it by season, split by whether they never or only occasionally trade at night.

p0012_2.t: Closing Times of Shops Trading at Night
p0012_2.d: Shops trading at night always or occasionally by their closing time of day, for fixed and seasonal closing times, with notes.

p0014_1.t: Shops and Employees by Length of the Working Day
p0014_1.d: Shops and their employees by whether all, some or none of the staff work more than ten hours a day, with employees by age group (under and over 16) and sex, and percentages.

p0015_1.t: Working Hours in Shops Trading by Day
p0015_1.d: Longest, shortest and average working day (hours:minutes) in shops that do not trade at night or trade at night occasionally.

p0015_2.t: Working Hours in Shops Trading at Night Without Shifts
p0015_2.d: Longest, shortest and average working day (hours:minutes) in shops trading at night always or occasionally without a shift system.

p0015_3.t: Working Hours in Shops Trading at Night With Shifts
p0015_3.d: Shops using two-, three- or four-shift systems for night trading: longest, shortest and average working hours of a shift and of the average shift per shop (hours:minutes), with notes.

p0016_1.d: Shift systems in shops trading at night by method and the hours worked by each shift (morning to evening, morning to night etc.), with numbers of shops trading at night always or occasionally.

p0019_1.t: Working Hours in Shops Using Shift Systems
p0019_1.d: Shops by shift system and method, with the longest and shortest hours of each shift and of the average shift per shop (hours:minutes), for shops trading at night always or occasionally.

p0019_2.d: Employees of shops trading at night by whether they work in shifts and by shift system and method, by sex, with totals and percentages.

p0020_1.t: Shops by Day on Which Shifts Change Over
p0020_1.d: Shops with shift systems by how often the shifts rotate (daily, weekly, every ten days etc.), with percentages.

p0020_2.t: Working Hours of Staff in Special Duties
p0020_2.d: Longest, shortest and average working day (hours:minutes) of night watchmen, kitchen staff, cleaners, dining-room staff, supervisors, delivery men, lift operators, cashiers, telephone operators and other special staff, with remarks.

p0021_1.t: [Staff in Special Duties by Working Pattern]
p0021_1.d: List of the special duties whose staff come in earlier, leave later, or keep different hours from ordinary shop assistants, grouped by pattern.

p0025_1.t: Shops and Employees by Whether Rest Periods Are Fixed
p0025_1.d: Shops and employees by whether a rest period is laid down, with percentages.

p0025_2.t: Shops by Total Length of Daily Rest Periods
p0025_2.d: Shops by total daily rest time, for shops giving the same rest to all staff and those giving different rest by staff or season, split by whether they fix meal breaks only or meal and ordinary breaks.

p0026_1.t: Shops by Whether Staff in Special Duties Have Fixed Rest Periods
p0026_1.d: Special duties (night watch, kitchen, cleaning, dining room and others) by number of shops reporting them and whether rest periods are fixed, not fixed or unknown.

p0026_2.t: [Shops by Length of Rest Periods of Staff in Special Duties]
p0026_2.d: List of special duties with the length of rest periods granted and the number of shops granting them.

p0027_1.t: Shops and Employees by Number of Regular Closing Days
p0027_1.d: Shops and their employees by whether the shop has regular closing days and how many a month, with percentages.

p0028_1.t: Shops by Whether They Have Special Closing Days
p0028_1.d: Shops by whether they close on special days (New Year etc.), with percentages and remarks.

p0029_1.t: Shops and Employees by Number of Regular Days Off
p0029_1.d: Shops and employees (by sex) by the number of regular days off a month, with percentages and notes.

p0030_1.t: Shops by Number of Special Holidays
p0030_1.d: Shops by the number of special holidays given to shop assistants, by kind (New Year, summer holiday, other leave) and total, with notes.

p0030_2.t: Shops by Total Days of Rest Available to Shop Assistants
p0030_2.d: Shops by the total number of days in the year a shop assistant may rest (regular and special holidays), with percentages.
